# Fantasy World Map Generator

> A free, open-source procedural fantasy map generator that runs entirely in the browser. It generates continents, rivers, biomes, nations, cities, roads and trade routes from a seed, simulates centuries of history, and exports print-ready posters and animated timelapses.

Live app: https://khalidibnwalid.github.io/map-generator/
Source code: https://github.com/khalidibnwalid/map-generator
Author: khalidibnwalid (https://github.com/khalidibnwalid)

Key facts:
- Runs client-side with WebGL2; no account, no server, no upload of your data.
- Deterministic: the same seed always produces the same world. A .world file stores the seed plus user edits.
- Map sizes: 400x225, 800x450, 1600x900 and 3200x1800 cells.
- Landmass presets: Heavy Landmass, Realistic Continents, Earthlike (tectonic), Pangea.
- Map styles: Realistic, Historical, Atlas.
- Outputs: high-resolution poster, nation fact sheets, animated GIF of the history timeline, .world save files.
- Built with TypeScript, Vite, WebGL2, simplex-noise and seedrandom.
